data.one_liner: A customizable popup window widget for Flutter
data.what_it_does: It displays an overlay window that can be positioned relative to the screen or a target widget. The API lets you control animation, background, dismissal behavior and content via a callback.
use_when: Need a lightweight, fully customizable popup or tooltip
Want to show contextual menus or small dialogs without using the full Dialog API
Need to position a widget relative to another widget or the screen
avoid_when: You need a full modal dialog with built‑in actions
You require complex navigation or state management inside the popup
strengths: Simple API with many customization options
Supports all Flutter platforms (web, desktop, mobile)
weaknesses: No built‑in theming or styling beyond basic colors
Limited to single‑purpose popups, not full dialogs
No support for complex nested navigation inside the popup
data.minimal_example:
showPopupWindow(
  context,
  gravity: KumiPopupGravity.rightBottom,
  bgColor: Colors.grey.withOpacity(0.5),
  childFun: (pop) => Container(
    padding: EdgeInsets.all(10),
    height: 100,
    width: 100,
    color: Colors.redAccent,
  ),
);
